profile.summary: Mike runs a two-van heating and cooling shop in Hagerstown with his nephew Jake, and calls often go to voicemail while they work.

items.title: Answer calls when you are on a job
items.why: You and Jake are in a attic or on a roof when the phone rings, so callers get voicemail and wait a couple of hours.

items.title: Write estimates faster
items.why: You write estimates on paper and email a copy later, which adds work after each visit.

items.title: Invoices and receipts
items.why: With two vans and just two people, paperwork lands on evenings and Saturdays.
